key_insight: Combining Neural Prophet with a Deep Neural Network (NP-DNN) yields more accurate stock price forecasts with better probabilistic (interval) predictions, improving the model's ability to quantify future price uncertainty.
problem_solved: Addresses the inability of many traditional time-series methods to reliably predict the probability range (uncertainty intervals) of future stock prices.
method: Hybrid architecture: Neural Prophet for trend/seasonality and event components, augmented by a deep neural network to model residuals and nonlinear relationships.
Produce probabilistic forecasts (prediction intervals) rather than point estimates to capture uncertainty in future prices.
Train and evaluate end-to-end on historical stock time-series with standard metrics for accuracy and interval coverage.
impact: Provides AI/ML practitioners a practical approach to obtain both accurate forecasts and calibrated uncertainty estimates for financial time series, aiding risk-aware trading and portfolio decisions.
visual_elements: Architecture diagram: Neural Prophet block feeding into a DNN residual learner (blocks and data flow).
Time-series plot with predicted median and shaded prediction intervals (before vs. after NP-DNN).
Benchmark bar chart: accuracy (MAE/RMSE) and interval coverage comparison versus baselines.
Pipeline flowchart showing data input, feature engineering, model training, and evaluation metrics.
paper_title: Stock Market Price Prediction using Neural Prophet with Deep Neural Network
paper_authors: Navin Chhibber, Suneel Khemka, Navneet Kumar Tyagi, Rohit Tewari, Bireswar Banerjee
